purpose: Enter a short verification code through one labelled native input while showing visual character slots.
avoid: Grouping must not obstruct paste or assistive technology.
basis: Native source page 101:698 (Input OPT), observed anatomy and examples.
profileRationale: The family presents controls or navigation; static depictions do not establish an interactive contract.
sourceRule: InputOTP forwards input-otp1.4.2 OTPInputProps, maxLength:number is required, value/defaultValue are strings, onChange(newValue:string) is not a native event callback. onComplete receives the complete value when a previously observed shorter value becomes exactly maxLength; initial full value is not an automatic completion request. It does not submit, verify, store or resend codes. The underlying library defaults inputMode=numeric and autoComplete=one-time-code, but only a supplied pattern enforces characters. This reference explicitly selects maxLength6 and REGEXP_ONLY_DIGITS, complete six slots indexed0..5, and a pasteTransformer removing spaces/hyphens. Pattern failure rejects the whole candidate rather than sanitizing arbitrary letters. Underlying selection, paste insertion, length truncation and fake caret use one actual input; slots/groups are visual divs. The reference explicitly hides visual slots and the separator from assistive technology while the real input remains labelled/exposed. Wrapper spellCheck=false can be overridden by native props. Disabled suppresses native user editing; controlled props remain authoritative and caller owns verification errors, cooldown and server response. The input-otp implementation also forwards native defaultValue alongside its internal value when supplied; React19 can warn about both. This reference deliberately uses the controlled string form.
keyboardAndFocus: The actual native input provides arrows, selection, Backspace/Delete, paste and one-time-code autofill. Tab enters one input, not six fake controls. Do not invent per-slot roving focus or automatic submission. Enter is ordinary native form behavior; onComplete only reports a filled code. Escape does not clear the code. Error text is explicit aria-describedby/aria-invalid; never identify codes only by color.
contentAlternative: Full code text/native input value/labelled slide text remains available without icon, fake caret, motion or hover. Caller owns exact help/error/recovery wording.
